meta.task_text: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.

threshold_parsing_notes.capacity_ah: nominal capacity judged on 1C DFN discharge capacity_ah; 60C judged in BOTH operating scenarios of the task: 4C fast charge at 45C (T_max_K, canonical Stage-4 exam) and 5C discharge at 25C (t_max_5c_k, mechanically copied from 5C output T_max_K into a derived metrics file)
threshold_parsing_notes.capacity_retention_5c: mechanically computed 5C capacity / same-params 1C capacity per SKILL Stage 3 rate-scenario rule, written to a derived metrics file for log-evaluate

meta.base_rationale: task text names no electrode system -> deterministic default Chen2020 per SKILL 1.5 anchor table; anchor verified by parameter dump: NMC811/graphite OCP set, Nominal cell capacity 5 Ah, SEI kinetics present, no native plating parameters (runtime-injected with trace), geometry/thermal keys native (Electrode height 0.065 m x width 1.58 m).
meta.test_fixture: Chen2020 initial-SOC artifact (cathode 27% lithiated, SKILL-documented: 'initial state is discharged') normalized to a standard fully-charged characterization state for ALL protocols; Initial concentration in positive electrode [mol.m-3] = 63104 (its maximum), Initial concentration in negative electrode [mol.m-3] = 33133 (its maximum). Constant across every candidate in this case (never varied between candidates) - test-condition normalization, NOT a design lever.
meta.ablation_set_by: defaults (task text names no ablation switches)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (task text does not lock the system; widest interpretation)

meta.freedoms_basis: zero-interaction rule: degrees of freedom not declared in the task text take the widest interpretation with an audit record (t1_r1 lesson)
meta.excluded_levers: solid-phase conductivity/diffusivity, initial concentration/lithiation variations (used only as the fixed test fixture above), initial SEI thickness, charge cut-off voltage

objective_breakdown: Five thresholds (verbatim): capacity >= 2 Ah (stage2, 1C DFN capacity_ah); 5C retention >= 95% (5C/1C capacity ratio, mechanical); 4C fast charge without plating (stage3, anode_potential_v min >= 0); T_max <= 60 C in BOTH scenarios (4C charge at 45C -> T_max_K; 5C discharge at 25C -> t_max_5c_k); power density >= 4000 W/kg (calc-energy P=V_OC^2/(4*DCR)/mass). Expected trade-offs: thin electrodes help power/rate but cut capacity-per-area (recovered by area, W/kg-neutral); DCR reduction serves metrics 2-5 at once; plating margin (N/P, anode porosity, particle size) trades against mass; T_max at 4C/45C has only 15 K headroom -> hardest metric.
candidate_strategy: R1: baseline characterization (all 4 protocols) + 2 power-direction variants (high-porosity variant; thin-electrode variant w/ area compensation); h held at contract default 10 in R1 to expose raw thermal gap. R2+: compose levers per measured gap (thickness/porosity/particle/N-P/separator/CC/electrolyte sigma/h). Each candidate gets full 1C/5C/4C + calc-energy suite and a log-evaluate entry (batch). Ceiling assessment: estimate P reachable ~4400-6000 W/kg within architecture+formulation space -> no Stage-2 material escalation expected; reassess only if R1 measurements contradict.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline+2 variants (3 evaluate entries); R2-R3 2-3 candidates/round to close gaps; R4 confirmation suite; residual rounds only if a metric within tuning distance; closing deliverables + verify + render + endorse(skip) + final.
risk_and_fallback: Risk A T_max 4C/45C unreachable -> DCR levers then h escalation (40-100 W/m2K forced-air class); if still short, three-strike questioning and honest negative final with precise relaxation noted. Risk B plating vs retention conflict -> decouple pos thickness / neg porosity. Risk C Chen2020 27%-SOC initial-state artifact -> global test fixture (entry-0 meta), not per-candidate. Risk D DFN stiffness -> auto SPMe fallback annotated honestly. Risk E solver failures -> verbatim record, fix, rerun.

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (Stage 3, executed at R1 baseline). Levers assessed: porosity (+0.065/+0.10), electrode thickness (-25.6/-29.2 um), particle radii, electrolyte sigma/D_e, cooling h. Measured R1: retention 8.7% (baseline) -> 18.7/18.9% (porosity/thickness families, ~2.2x each); power density already 22.4-24.5 kW/kg vs 4 kW/kg target (contract formula; DCR 4.1-5.4 mOhm); capacity 3.2-4.95 Ah > 2 Ah. Gap attribution: 5C collapse is transport, not ohmic - positive solid-diffusion tau ~ 6800 s (r=5.22 um, D=4e-15) vs 720 s test, plus liquid-phase limitations; 4C plating is anode charge-acceptance (r_neg, eps_neg, N/P, sigma); 4C T_max is heat-vs-cooling (h). Conclusion: objective is within architecture+formulation reach - particle-size (tau ~ r^2), electrolyte transport overrides, porosity/thickness composition and cooling h close the gap; NO Stage-2 material escalation (gap is transport kinetics, not potential-window/stability, which are the Stage-2 responsibility).

reason: R1 measurements overturn the plan's expectation that DCR/power density is the binding constraint (measured 22.4-24.5 kW/kg vs 4000 target with DCR 4.1-5.4 mOhm). Binding metrics are 5C retention (8.7-18.9%) and 4C plating/T_max; root cause localized to solid-diffusion (tau_pos ~ 6800 s) + liquid transport at the CELL scale (Stage 3), not materials potential window.
candidate_strategy: R2 multi-lever power stack: particle radii pos 5.22->1.3 um, neg 5.86->1.6 um (tau ~ r^2, the dominant 5C lever, admin by SKILL Stage 3 'small particle -> high rate'); porosity 0.45/0.40; thickness 45/56 um; electrolyte overrides sigma=1.5 S/m and diffusivity=6e-10 m2/s (literature-informed formulation bridge estimates, listed before run); paired attribution candidate P2 with base particle radii and same other levers. NEW DESIGN RULE (audited here): C-rate protocol currents reference 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]', so each candidate's nominal is re-based to its delivered 1C capacity (iterative, converged to <2% drift) so 5C/4C protocols test true C-rates of the resized power cell - otherwise thinned stacks would be tested at the base 5-Ah currents while rated by their own smaller capacity.
budget_allocation: R2: 2 candidates (power stack + no-particle attribution). R3: thermal management h sizing + retention/plating fine tuning (1-2 candidates). R4: best-candidate confirmation + safety re-check, then deliverables closing.
risk_and_fallback: If retention stalls below ~80% after the particle+electrolyte stack: re-check the liquid-phase limitation by diagnosing salt concentration profiles (DFN internal variables readout), then adjust D_e/sigma/porosity once more. If 4C T_max stays above 333.15 K with h=100: three-strike questioning (thermal boundary: cooling-area parameter and h upper bounds) before any negative close.

llm_reason: Ceiling assessment attributed the 5C collapse to solid-diffusion + liquid transport (both Stage 3). P1 stacks the two strongest levers (r^2 particle scaling; sigma/D_e/porosity/thickness); P2 isolates attribution. Parameter values and sources (pre-run listing): r_pos 1.3 um / r_neg 1.6 um = commercially available sub-2 um NMC and fine graphite powders (domain experience, no precise source pinned); sigma 1.5 S/m, D_e 6e-10 m2/s = high-transport liquid-electrolyte formulation values (literature-informed estimate; baseline Nyman2008 function evaluates ~0.9-1.0 S/m at 1M 25C); nominal capacity re-based per candidate to its delivered 1C capacity (audited design rule in plan update r1) so 5C/4C are true C-rates.
